 Providence Christian knocks off DCA 35-14 
 By Monte Hale 
 on 
 November 06, 2026 
 POST REPORT 
 PCA advanced to the quarterfinals of the Division II-A state playoffs with a resounding 35-14 win over DCA at MTSU’s Floyd Stadium Thursday night.
 The No. 3 seeded Lions (7-4) avenged a 21-point loss to DCA (6-5), 49-28, in the regular season. PCA will play at No. 1 seed USJ Friday, Nov. 13.
 PCA’s Garrison Dedman racked up over 220 yards on the ground, and quarterback Nate Lamb threw two touchdown passes and rushed for another.
